summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed Form 6-K reporting a routine daily tranche of its ongoing share buy-back program announced 5 August 2026. On 1 September 2026, HSBC repurchased 608,000 shares on UK venues at a VWAP of £15.0933 and 327,200 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$159.6358, all for cancellation. Since program commencement, HSBC has repurchased 24,797,814 shares for approximately US$510.6 million. Shares were bought from BNP Paribas as principal. Post-cancellation issued capital totals 17,166,083,783 shares. This is a routine buy-back execution update; watch cumulative repurchases versus announced authorization.
